1.web: Brothers, I couldn’t speak to you as to spiritual, but as to fleshly, as to babies in Christ.
1.asv: And I, brethren, could not speak unto you as unto spiritual, but as unto carnal, as unto babes in Christ.

2.web: I fed you with milk, not with meat; for you weren’t yet ready. Indeed, not even now are you ready,
2.asv: I fed you with milk, not with meat; for ye were not yet able to bear it: nay, not even now are ye able;

3.web: for you are still fleshly. For insofar as there is jealousy, strife, and factions among you, aren’t you fleshly, and don’t you walk in the ways of men?
3.asv: for ye are yet carnal: for whereas there is among you jealousy and strife, are ye not carnal, and do ye not walk after the manner of men?

4.web: For when one says, “I follow Paul,” and another, “I follow Apollos,” aren’t you fleshly?
4.asv: For when one saith, I am of Paul; and another, I am of Apollos; are ye not men?

5.web: Who then is Apollos, and who is Paul, but servants through whom you believed; and each as the Lord gave to him?
5.asv: What then is Apollos? and what is Paul? Ministers through whom ye believed; and each as the Lord gave to him.

6.web: I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.
6.asv: I planted, Apollos watered; but God gave the increase.

7.web: So then neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.
7.asv: So then neither is he that planteth anything, neither he that watereth; but God that giveth the increase.

8.web: Now he who plants and he who waters are the same, but each will receive his own reward according to his own labor.
8.asv: Now he that planteth and he that watereth are one: but each shall receive his own reward according to his own labor.

9.web: For we are God’s fellow workers. You are God’s farming, God’s building.
9.asv: For we are God’s fellow-workers: ye are God’s husbandry, God’s building.

10.web: According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another builds on it. But let each man be careful how he builds on it.
10.asv: According to the grace of God which was given unto me, as a wise masterbuilder I laid a foundation; and another buildeth thereon. But let each man take heed how he buildeth thereon.

11.web: For no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid, which is Jesus Christ.
11.asv: For other foundation can no man lay than that which is laid, which is Jesus Christ.

12.web: But if anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay, or stubble;
12.asv: But if any man buildeth on the foundation gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay, stubble;

13.web: each man’s work will be revealed. For the Day will declare it, because it is revealed in fire; and the fire itself will test what sort of work each man’s work is.
13.asv: each man’s work shall be made manifest: for the day shall declare it, because it is revealed in fire; and the fire itself shall prove each man’s work of what sort it is.

14.web: If any man’s work remains which he built on it, he will receive a reward.
14.asv: If any man’s work shall abide which he built thereon, he shall receive a reward.

15.web: If any man’s work is burned, he will suffer loss, but he himself will be saved, but as through fire.
15.asv: If any man’s work shall be burned, he shall suffer loss: but he himself shall be saved; yet so as through fire.

16.web: Don’t you know that you are a temple of God, and that God’s Spirit lives in you?
16.asv: Know ye not that ye are a temple of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you?

17.web: If anyone destroys the temple of God, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, which you are.
17.asv: If any man destroyeth the temple of God, him shall God destroy; for the temple of God is holy, and such are ye.

18.web: Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool, that he may become wise.
18.asv: Let no man deceive himself. If any man thinketh that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool, that he may become wise.

19.web: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, “He has taken the wise in their craftiness.”
19.asv: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, He that taketh the wise in their craftiness:

20.web: And again, “The Lord knows the reasoning of the wise, that it is worthless.”
20.asv: and again, The Lord knoweth the reasonings of the wise, that they are vain.

21.web: Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,
21.asv: Wherefore let no one glory in men. For all things are yours;

22.web: whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come. All are yours,
22.asv: whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come; all are yours;

23.web: and you are Christ’s, and Christ is God’s.
23.asv: and ye are Christ’s; and Christ is God’s.
